name: Corporate Images Inc./ Embroidery By Design
old_description: We have managed event merchandise and brand activation programs from our Denver facility since 1979. Gate giveaways, kitted drops, and scheduled seasonal activations — sourced, decorated, and fulfilled in-house.
about:
Corporate Images Inc., operating as Embroidery By Design, has managed event merchandise and brand activation programs from its Denver, Colorado facility since 1979. The company was founded as a managed apparel and branded merchandise partner, providing in-house decoration and fulfillment services.

The company provides end-to-end uniform and apparel programs, event merchandise, and brand activation services. All production occurs under one roof: embroidery, screen printing, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, kitting, and fulfillment. With a staff of 50, Corporate Images manages inventory, operates client ordering portals, handles budget reporting, and provides customer service. The firm handles high-volume projects such as gate giveaways of 25,000+ shirts for events with up to 39,000 attendees, and daily drop-ship fulfillment for a national retailer with 2,500 locations.

Clients span transportation and fleet, hospitality and restaurant, enterprise retail, sports and events, healthcare, field services, and corporate sectors. Examples include a national carrier with 3,400 drivers across 22 states using a centralized ordering portal, a regional restaurant group with 200 employees across 14 locations, and a national retailer with 2,500 locations receiving daily drop-ship fulfillment.

Corporate Images differentiates itself through vertical integration — controlling every step from art approval to shipment — to ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints. The company emphasizes brand stewardship, offering a single account relationship, unified logo files and color standards, and portal-based program management with built-in budget controls and reporting.
